title: Attribution Proposal
description: attribution-proposal/v1 — the priced list the pledging side offers to deliver against a report, for the approver to accept or refuse as a whole. It is the document the approver consents to, so it carries the valuation as well as the quantities: what the approver signs is what a later evaluation may credit. Nothing is per-line — an approver that will not take the list refuses it and the pledger proposes another.

metadata.description: The valuation offered for this line, recorded exactly as it was sent. Every value is a decimal string; any rounding is the author's own.

appliedHaircut.description: The haircut taken on this asset, as a decimal string.

baseUnitPrice.description: Unit price before the haircut, as a decimal string.

baseValue.description: Value of this line before the haircut, as a decimal string.

baseUnits.description: Units before the haircut, as a decimal string.

finalUnitPrice.description: Unit price after the haircut, as a decimal string. Coverage values a holding at quantity × finalUnitPrice, so this is carried rather than divided out of finalValue.

finalValue.description: Value of this line after the haircut, as a decimal string.

finalUnits.description: Units after the haircut, as a decimal string.

haircutApplyMethod.description: How the haircut was applied when this line's valuation was calculated. reduce-from-price = the haircut was taken off the unit price, leaving the units unchanged; add-to-total = the haircut was covered by calling for more units. Recorded for display and audit only — no reader applies it, and readers must not treat this list as closed: further methods are expected and will extend it. Stated per line because each line carries its own valuation.

line.description: One asset the pledging side offers to deliver, with the valuation it is offered at.

quantity.description: Units offered, as a decimal string.

reportId.description: The report this list would satisfy. The event also references the authoring margin-report event, which is the protocol-level counterpart of this field.

proposalId.description: This proposal. A later proposal on the same report is a fresh list, not a revision of this one.

round.description: 1 on the first proposal for a report, incrementing when a refused list is followed by another.

lines.description: The offered list. An empty list is not a proposal.
